description: Answers HMRC's sign-in link for this session, so the VAT tools can call HMRC without a token in the chat. Answers {url, expiresAt, scope, hmrcAccount}: show the user the url, wait for them to say HMRC access is granted, then call list_vat_obligations or submit_vat_return. The link works once, for ten minutes. DIY Accounting Submit keeps HMRC's tokens itself and renews the access token for the rest of the session. A second call replaces the session's authorisation. hmrcAccount synthetic is HMRC's sandbox. Over the deployed API.

hmrcAccount.description: Which HMRC environment: live (the default) or synthetic

services.description: The HMRC services to ask access for: vat (the default), itsa, and agent (the practice tools invite_client and client_authorisation_status)

name: request_hmrc_authorisation
